summary: Luda Technology Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K press release announcing the appointment of Dyna Segmen Ltd. as its authorized non-exclusive agent in Kazakhstan to support future data centre and pipeline opportunities. No financial terms, stake percentages, or transaction details were disclosed. The board did not provide a recommendation; no advisors were named. This is a routine commercial agency agreement and does not constitute a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer update with no change of control or capital structure impact. Watch for any subsequent material agreements or project awards that may emerge from this agency relationship.
